title: 螺旋矩阵 IV
summary: 把链表节点值按顺时针螺旋顺序填入 m×n 矩阵，未被链表覆盖的格子填负一。
insight: 矩阵先填负一；当前位置写入节点值后尝试沿当前方向前进，若越界或下一格已填写就顺时针转向。
pitfalls: 链表长度不超过矩阵容量
未访问格与链表值可用负一明确区分
最后一个节点写完后无需继续移动

solutions.title: 转向模拟螺旋填充
solutions.idea: 用已填矩阵本身标记访问状态。
steps: matrix 全填 -1，位置 (0,0)，方向向右
计算下一格；若越界或不为 -1，方向顺时针旋转后重算

code.java: class Solution { public int[][] spiralMatrix(int m,int n,ListNode head){int[][] matrix=new int[m][n];for(int[] row:matrix)Arrays.fill(row,-1);int[][] directions={{0,1},{1,0},{0,-1},{-1,0}};int row=0,column=0,direction=0;for(ListNode node=head;node!=null;node=node.next){matrix[row][column]=node.val;int nr=row+directions[direction][0],nc=column+directions[direction][1];if(nr<0||nr>=m||nc<0||nc>=n||matrix[nr][nc]!=-1){direction=(direction+1)%4;nr=row+directions[direction][0];nc=column+directions[direction][1];}row=nr;column=nc;}return matrix;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun spiralMatrix(m:Int,n:Int,head:ListNode?):Array<IntArray>{val matrix=Array(m){IntArray(n){-1}};val directions=arrayOf(intArrayOf(0,1),intArrayOf(1,0),intArrayOf(0,-1),intArrayOf(-1,0));var row=0;var column=0;var direction=0;var node=head;while(node!=null){matrix[row][column]=node.`val`;var nr=row+directions[direction][0];var nc=column+directions[direction][1];if(nr !in 0 until m||nc !in 0 until n||matrix[nr][nc]!=-1){direction=(direction+1)%4;nr=row+directions[direction][0];nc=column+directions[direction][1]};row=nr;column=nc;node=node.next};return matrix} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<vector<int>> spiralMatrix(int m,int n,ListNode* head){vector matrix(m,vector<int>(n,-1));int directions[5]={0,1,0,-1,0},row=0,column=0,direction=0;for(ListNode* node=head;node;node=node->next){matrix[row][column]=node->val;int nr=row+directions[direction],nc=column+directions[direction+1];if(nr<0||nr>=m||nc<0||nc>=n||matrix[nr][nc]!=-1){direction=(direction+1)%4;nr=row+directions[direction];nc=column+directions[direction+1];}row=nr;column=nc;}return matrix;} };
